passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My favorite toy is a robot.
Its arm can move, and a light turns on.
phrases.ko: 로봇의 팔은 움직일 수 있고, 불빛이 켜져요.

phrases.en: It is a gift from my mom.
I play with my toy, and I take care of it.
phrases.ko: 나는 장난감을 가지고 놀고, 소중히 다뤄요.

phrases.en: The small robot sits on my desk.
phrases.ko: 작은 로봇은 내 책상 위에 있어요.

phrases.en: When the light is on, my sister smiles.
Mom gave me this gift on my birthday.
phrases.ko: 엄마는 내 생일에 이 선물을 주었어요.

phrases.en: A favorite toy can be small and still special.
phrases.ko: 가장 좋아하는 장난감은 작아도 특별할 수 있어요.

phrases.en: I thank my mom for the red robot.
phrases.ko: 나는 빨간 로봇을 준 엄마에게 감사해요.

full_passage_spoken: My favorite toy is a robot. It is red and small. Its arm can move, and a light turns on. It is a gift from my mom. I play with my toy, and I take care of it. The small robot sits on my desk. When the light is on, my sister smiles. Mom gave me this gift on my birthday. I move the arm slowly. A favorite toy can be small and still special. I thank my mom for the red robot.
